english.title: Person persistently loiter for the purposes of prostitution
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) persistently loitered in a street or public place, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), for the purpose of prostitution
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) and (2) of the Street Offences Act 1959.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
persistently loitered in street/public place for purpose of prostitution

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
This offence substituted by section 16 of the Policing and Crime Act 2009.

"Persistently" means two or more occasions within a three month period. (section 1(4) of the Street Offences Act 1959 as amended).
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant persistently loitered in a street or public place, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), for the purpose of prostitution.
